text:
IncidentBot: P0 ALERT — high anomalous cross-tenant KV reads detected on dedicated pool gpud-14 (region: eu-west-1).
IncidentBot: Symptoms: sustained 5xx rate spike from routing layer + KV fetches returning keys with foreign tenant prefix. Potential tenant-isolation violation. Impact: Synthara (cust-3387) reported intermittent sensitive response leaks.
Alex O.: Oncall here. I’m pulling traces and will start a containment plan. Priya, can you grab the control-plane routing snapshot?
Priya S.: pulling now. grabbing last config commit: r2026. Kicking off a config-diff between 12:34 and 12:50 UTC.
Tom H.: attaching quick grep from kv readlogs (redacted):

```
2026-09-11T12:41:03Z pool=gpud-14 tenant=atlas-091 read_key=syn-3387/config -> returned payload for tenant syn-3387
2026-09-11T12:41:04Z pool=gpud-14 tenant=synthara-3387 read_key=atlas-091/cache -> returned payload for tenant atlas-091
```

Tom H.: looks like prefix mixing. Not just duplicated logs — actual cross-tenant payload observed.
Cleo R.: security: collect evidence, DO NOT purge logs. Preserve disk images if we evict nodes. We need chain-of-custody for legal and customer breach analysis.
Alex O.: Agreed. Tom, snapshot current kvstore and core dumps to /tmp/incident-synthara-2987. Opsbot, start ephemeral backup job.
opsbot: backup job started (job_id: bk-2987-eu1). ETA 12m.
Priya S.: control-plane diff shows a routing optimizer job that applied a prefix-trim patch at 12:40 — commit r2026 applied to gpud-14 routing-table. Looks benign but overlap with dedicated-pool shadowing logic.
Andy L.: Immediate mitigation proposal: 1) remove gpud-14 from public routing (drain), 2) pin Synthara to a cold standby pool without spillover, 3) enable strict tenant namespace enforcement flag (feature: tenant-enforce-strict=true).
Alex O.: I’ll do a graceful drain now. Command: `redwood infra drain-node --node gpud-14 --reason \"isolation-oscillation-pager\"`
Tom H.: while draining, I’m snapshotting KV shards (shard ids: 7,8,9). Also pulling KV get histories for keys with both tenant prefixes.

```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED\" \"https://metrics.internal/api/v1/query?query=kv_read_errors{pool=\"gpud-14\"}\"\n```

Tom H.: Found ~450 reads in 2m window that returned mismatched prefix. Trace IDs saved to /tmp/traces/synthara-crossreads-2987.log
Cleo R.: Start customer comms: Jorge (SE) coordinate, notify Synthara legal contact and SOC. Draft language: "We are investigating an isolation anomaly on a dedicated pool; at this stage we are mitigation-ingress and preserving logs; we will follow up within 3 hours with a status update."
Jorge (SE): I’ll take lead on customer update. Need expected timeline and whether keys were exfiltrated. Alex/Tom, give me a short blurb and ETA for next update.
Alex O.: ETA: 45m for containment status (drain+isolation). Short blurb: "We identified anomalous cross-tenant KV reads on your dedicated pool. We are actively isolating affected nodes, preserving all logs and snapshots, and will provide a detailed timeline shortly."
Priya S.: control-plane flag flip command ready: `redwood controlplane set-flag tenant-enforce-strict true --scope gpud-14` — requires 2 approvals. Who can approve?
Andy L.: I approve. @Cleo R. can you approve for security?
Cleo R.: approved. Execute.
Alex O.: executing toggle now.

```
redwood controlplane set-flag tenant-enforce-strict true --scope gpud-14 --run-by alex.o
```

opsbot: feature flag applied on 3/3 nodes in gpud-14. Enforcement mode: strict.
Tom H.: after flag, cross-tenant reads dropped to 0 in 30s window. but still monitoring, some inflight KV RPCs may return stale results.
Alex O.: drain progress: 60% of active connections evicted gracefully. Starting live-eviction for remaining sessions to cut blast radius.
Priya S.: capturing routing table snapshot post-flag. Not seeing obvious policy collision, but there was a transient routing rewrite triggered by optimizer job that ran prior to r2026. Need to correlate optimizer inputs.
Cleo R.: preserve a forensic copy of the node's volatile memory. If we evict, we must preserve image. Tom/Alex coordinate with infra-sre and legal for chain-of-custody.
Tom H.: copying memdump -> s3://incidents/prod/2987654321/memdumps/gpud-14-0.dmp (access: security+oncall).
Alex O.: handover plan: current oncall will remain until containment confirmed. After containment and snapshot verification, I’ll hand to Priya for root-cause and to Cleo for legal summary.
Jorge (SE): Customer notified with initial blurb, asked for immediate confirmation of PII exposure. They want an estimated MTTI and will open a ticket with their security team.
Andy L.: follow-ups: 1) schedule emergency postmortem 2) add a dedicated test to the optimizer job to validate prefix isolation before rollout 3) add an alert that watches for tenant-prefix collisions across pools.
Cleo R.: legal asked: preserve communication logs, do not contact other customers directly. SE can coordinate.
Tom H.: quick forensic note: we found a small window where the optimizer rewrote canonical prefixes when SHARD_REASSIGN=true. That code path previously had a guard that accidentally bypassed tenant normalization on dedicated pools. patch queued.
Priya S.: rolling a hotfix: branch `fix/tenant-prefix-guard` ready, CI green. Planning canary deploy to staging then prod. ETA to prod: 3h if post-checks pass.
Alex O.: status update for incident channel in 30m. Current impact: Synthara reported intermittent exposures (under investigation). Containment: enforced tenant isolation flag + node drain in progress + backups collected.
Jorge (SE): will relay containment message to Synthara now. They requested token rotation for any keys used in the implicated interval; we should coordinate with their engineering contact.
Andy L.: Ops action for token rotation: issue short-lived tokens and rotate KMS keys for affected tenant vaults. Checklist: revoke active tokens -> issue rotation plan -> update customer.
Cleo R.: make sure all relevant audit logs are copied to an immutable store. Also capture the list of affected trace IDs and which tenants saw reads.
Tom H.: attached trace summary (redacted): 37 unique trace IDs showed cross-tenant read. I’ve flagged them in the trace service and linked them to bk-2987 job.
Alex O.: final operational note before handoff: do NOT delete gpud-14 artifacts until infra postmortem complete. Priya, take lead on RCA. Cleo, you’ll coordinate legal. Jorge -> continue customer comms. I’ll update after drain finishes.
opsbot: drain complete on gpud-14. Node removed from routing. backup job bk-2987 completed.
Priya S.: accepted handoff. starting RCA timeline collection.
Cleo R.: accepted handoff for compliance & legal. logging chain-of-custody ticket: LEGAL-2987.
Jorge (SE): Synthara acknowledged containment and asked for interim incident report in 2 hours. I’ll draft with what we have.
Alex O.: handing off oncall to Priya in 10m for RCA; I’ll remain reachable for questions. If anything regresses, page me immediately. :thumbsup:
Priya S.: thanks — will create infra-postmortem doc and include mitigation playbook so we can run faster next time.
Cleo R.: record of actions:
- 12:40 UTC optimizer job r2026 applied
- 12:41 UTC anomalous cross-tenant reads observed
- 12:43 UTC Incident P0 triggered
- 12:46 UTC tenant-enforce-strict flag applied to gpud-14
- 12:52 UTC gpud-14 drained and removed from routing
- 13:00 UTC backups & memdumps completed

Alex O.: closing loop here for live mitigation. Priya/Cleo/Jorge to lead next steps. Will create incident channel summary and link evidence.
opsbot: incident channel archived when thread closed.
Priya S.: (post-note) starting timeline doc: https://redwood-internal.docs/incidents/2987654321 — will populate.
Cleo R.: legal note: keep this thread and attachments for 7 years per retention rule until legal signs off.
Jorge (SE): thanks team. ongoing updates in infra-postmortem.
